message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine correct label(s) based on facts. The case: illegal hunting of protected animals. The facts: using self-made chain to illegally capture 2 national second-level protected animals (original chickens? Actually "原鸡" maybe a protected species). They killed and stored for consumption. This is illegal hunting/killing of protected wildlife. According to correction lessons: "非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物" is correct label for illegal hunting/killing of protected wildlife. The lesson says: correct label 【非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物】 (not “非法狩猎”). So we should use that label.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物<eoa>
